description: Statutory approval pathway gating a data centre build. Each entry becomes a gating milestone with a finish-to-start constraint (DOMAIN_KNOWLEDGE.md section 5).
provenance_summary: MIXED, and the split matters. The AUTHORITY NAMES and the existence of each approval are transcribed from DOMAIN_KNOWLEDGE.md section 5 (CIDCO/MIDC, SEIAA, MPCB, State Fire Services, CEIG, PESO). The DURATIONS are INDUSTRY ESTIMATES - typical elapsed times, not measured from any submission. Statutory durations vary enormously with completeness of submission and authority workload. DOMAIN_KNOWLEDGE.md section 5 states plainly that the exact set varies by city, parcel and project and is confirmed with the compliance team, so this is a template of the right shape rather than a statement of what this project needs. NOT LEGAL ADVICE. The compliance register must be approved in admin before driving a live plan.

provenance.note: Authority and approval type from docs/DOMAIN_KNOWLEDGE.md#5. DURATION IS AN ESTIMATE. PESO licence for bulk HSD storage serving the generators; layout approval then licence. BLOCKS NARROWED FOR REVIEW: was ["commissioning"], which held the entire commissioning stage behind a diesel-storage licence and so gated L1 factory acceptance testing. A PESO licence covers bulk HSD storage and the fuel system, so it now blocks "genset_fuel_systems" - the generator installation and the bulk storage tank. This is a DATA CORRECTION and wants a compliance reviewer: if the client reads PESO as gating any commissioning that runs the gensets under load, the L5 integrated systems test belongs in this list too.
